item.title: Jonathan Greer to be nominated for SBC recording secretary
item.description: A Mississippi pastor has become the third known candidate to be nominated for Southern Baptist Convention recording secretary.

item.title: Baylor Regents celebrate milestones and new program
item.description: The Baylor University Board of Regents celebrated fundraising, graduation milestones, and introduced a Bachelor of Science in biomedical engineering.

item.title: Russia/Ukraine war entering fourth year
item.description: Feb. 24, 2026 marks the fourth anniversary of Russia’s full-scale military invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian and Texas Baptists commented on the occasion.

item.title: Equip: The importance of learning the biblical languages
item.description: Joshua Sharp explains the importance of learning Greek and Hebrew for studying Scripture and suggests resources.

item.title: Voices: Ten Commandments law and adult hypocrisies
item.description: The Ten Commandments are “ordered” by law to be posted in Texas public schools. The intent? Because we supposedly “support Judeo-Christian values.” Yet, the Ten Commandments are Mosaic, not Christian....

item.title: Texas Baptists ‘are a people of the book,’ Guarneri declares
item.description: BGCT Executive Director Julio Guarneri appeals to Texas Baptists’ historic stance on Scripture to encourage new vision and cooperation.

item.title: McRaney case declined, ending NAMB lawsuit
item.description: SCOTUS declined to hear a years-long case brought by former Baptist state convention executive director Will McRaney against NAMB.

item.title: Voices: Sharia law and championing religious liberty
item.description: Jack Goodyear calls Christians not to participate in fearmongering but to embody the gospel by standing with religious minorities.

item.title: Around the State: HPU names five Currie-Strickland scholars
item.description: Howard Payne University named five students as Currie-Strickland scholars during the 18th annual Currie-Strickland Distinguished Lectures in Christian Ethics in February.

item.title: Historically Black churches receive millions in grants
item.description: Sixteenth Street Baptist Church in Birmingham, Ala., and Atlanta’s Ebenezer Baptist Church are among 33 Black churches receiving millions of dollars for preservation of their sacred and historic buildings.
